title: Chicken Lemon Pepperpot
description: A zesty chicken and potato stew simmered in stock with lemon pepper seasoning, butter beans and a finish of fresh lemon juice.
ingredients: 6 chicken thigh fillets (about 600g/1lb 5oz), fat trimmed away
450g (1lb) potatoes, peeled and cut into bite-sized chunks
400g (14oz) can of butter beans, drained and rinsed
small handful of parsley leaves, finely chopped
steps: Spray a large, deep flameproof casserole dish (with a lid) with oil and fry the chicken thigh fillets over a medium heat for 5 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic and fry for a further 5 minutes, stirring regularly.
Stir in the lemon pepper and cornflour.
Pour in the hot stock and add the potatoes and butter beans, place the lid on and simmer over a gentle heat for 30 minutes.
Stir in the lemon juice, then remove the chicken thigh fillets and slice finely before stirring back into the sauce. Scatter with parsley before serving.
notes: Parsnips or sweet potatoes work well as alternatives to potato. For children, omit lemon pepper and use finely grated lemon zest instead.
